interpretation_notes: Fees are calculations, not pass/fail checks. Building permission fee (21(3)(b)) uses the slab for the proposed built-up area; slab edges are printed as whole numbers (0–75, 76–125, ...), so a value between two slabs (e.g. 75.5) goes to manual review. Multipliers by use: shops/commercial/industrial +50% (item 2), shop-cum-residence +50% (item 4), administrative block / social / educational / other = item 1. High-rise (Rule 2(38)) uses 21(3)(c): Rs 10 per sq m of built-up area; commercial +100%; shop-cum-residence +50%. Farm house and agricultural tourist facility are not listed → manual review. Development permission fee (21(3)(a)) is per hectare by land-use zone and planning-area population; whether a part hectare is charged pro-rata is not stated → note. Bhopal's planning-area population must be entered by the user (not assumed).
